dct_description_sm: To obtain accurate, current information on the harvest of Qamanirjuaq caribou to assist with conservation of the herd and protection of the traditional subsistence caribou harvest.Short-term Objectives (Kivalliq sub-project):1)To estimate the numbers of Qamanirjuaq caribou harvested by Kivalliq communities annually.2)To obtain quantitative and qualitative information on the annual harvest of caribou by harvesters from the five Kivalliq communities which harvest the Qamanirjuaq caribou herd (Arviat, Baker Lake, Chesterfield Inlet, Rankin Inlet*, Whale Cove).3)To assess the economic value of the estimated annual harvest of Qamanirjuaq caribou to Kivalliq communities.Medium-term objectives (multi-jurisdictional project):1)To estimate the total harvest of Qamanirjuaq caribou in a given year**.2)To obtain quantitative and qualitative information on the annual harvest of Qamanirjuaq caribou by communities across the caribou range.3)To assess the economic value of the estimated annual harvest of Qamanirjuaq caribou, as well as value of the harvest to individual regions of the caribou range, using an appraisal that incorporates all categories of harvest.4)To identify if the total harvest of the Qamanirjuaq herd is currently at a level that is sustainable in relation to the herds current size and trend.*Rankin Inlet is collecting information using a different approach but collaborating with the project.**Total harvest includes:i) all categories of harvest - traditional subsistence harvest, harvest for private sales and inter-regional trade, resident (licensed) harvest, non-resident (outfitted) harvest and commercial harvest andii) harvest in all regions of the caribou range - in the southern Kivalliq region of  Nunavut, eastern Northwest Territories, northern Saskatchewan and northern Manitoba.
dct_subject_sm: Social sciences, economics and policy -> Conservation
dct_title_s: Monitoring Harvest of the Qamanirjuaq Caribou Herd and Estimating the Economic Value of the Harvest for Five Mainland Kivalliq Communities (NGMP ID EC42)
